# Getting help

## Installation and configuration

Start with the [installation guide](../docs/getting-started.md),
[published-image instructions](../docs/operations/install-release.md) or
[Danish beginner guide](../docs/onboarding/kom-i-gang.da.md).
The [documentation index](../docs/README.md) covers configuration, updates,
backups, integrations and the API.

## Questions and bug reports

[Search existing issues](https://github.com/Media-manager52/Media-manager/issues)
before opening a new one. If you still need help,
[choose an issue form](https://github.com/Media-manager52/Media-manager/issues/new/choose)
for a bug, setup question or feature request. English and Danish are welcome.

Include your Media Manager version or commit and how you installed it. For a
bug, describe what you expected, what happened and how to reproduce it.
Short, redacted logs or a screenshot can help; do not share tokens, passwords,
private addresses, media paths or complete environment files.

## Security reports

Report suspected vulnerabilities [privately](https://github.com/Media-manager52/Media-manager/security/advisories/new),
as described in the [security policy](../SECURITY.md).

## Contributions

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for development, verification and
pull request guidance. This is an owner-maintained beta; support and review
are provided as time permits.
